text: FN Site 107 is a Miranium Deposit in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in Primordia, on the beach near New Los Angeles.

The Scenic Viewpoint Abyss Reservoir can be found to the southwest at the base of the large tower. Luxaar's Xern can be seen in the distance.

FN Site 419 is a Miranium Deposit in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in Sylvalum, on Delusians South Summit.

FN Site 420 is a Miranium Deposit in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in Sylvalum, on a raised platform. Although there appears to be no enemies present, there is a sound-sensitive Zig on a platform below the edge which will attack lower leveled parties.
FN Site 501 is a Miranium Deposit in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in northwestern Cauldros, on the Far Isle of Tzu'o.

FN Site 502 is a Miranium Deposit in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located at the Scholes Battlegrounds in southwestern Cauldros, near the path to Sylvalum. The sightseeing location Infernal Ledges, an Unexplored Territory, can be found north of Drongo Caravan.
FN Site 503 is a Miranium Deposit in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in Cauldros, in the White Phosphor Lake. It is guarded by a single Fighter Puge.
FN Site 504 is a Miranium Deposit in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in Cauldros.

FN Site 505 is a Miranium Deposit in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located on the lower level of Cauldros. An easy approach for beginners is to swim along the northwestern side of Cauldros towards the north until the path inland is found. Continuing along the path southeast leads to the Scenic Viewpoint Beneath O'rrh Sim Keep and eventually to FN Site 506. Beyond the lava to the northeast lies the entrance to the Unexplored Territory Ganglion Antropolis. The Emerian Battlegrounds can be found by going onto the upper level after following the southwest path. The Rocky Lagoon BC is located just southeast of here.

FN Site 506 is a Miranium Deposit in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in middle of three rock formations on the lower level of Cauldros, south of FN Site 505. By approaching from FN Site 505, the path first leads southeast to the Scenic Viewpoint Beneath O'rrh Sim Keep before turning southwest where the deposit lies.

FN Site 507 is a Miranium Deposit in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in Cauldros, inside a cave on Slavebird Isle. The cave's entrance is located on top of the Isle, on a side path below the group of Marnuck on the east side.
FN Site 508 is a Miranium Deposit in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in Cauldros.
FN Site 509 is a Miranium Deposit in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in Cauldros. There are no enemies nearby.
FN Site 511 is a Miranium Deposit in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in Cauldros, on the T'phnom Shelf.
FN Site 512 is a Miranium Deposit in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in Cauldros, within the Kitsune Stronghold.

FN Site 513 is a Miranium Deposit in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in Cauldros, on a platform within the M'gando Volcanic Crater. There are no enemies here. The nearby sightseeing spot is the M'gando Mineral Spring Unexplored Territory. This site is accessible without a Skell by reaching the summit of Mount M'gando, running around the lip of the volcano, jumping down and falling on the ledge.
FN Site 514 is a Miranium Deposit in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in Cauldros, at the Kw'arah Cloister.
FN Site 515 is a Miranium Deposit in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located on the southeast coast of Cauldros.
Everwhelm Falls (Japanese: , Hisamasu Bakufu) is a landmark in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in Noctilum, southeast of FN Site 204.

Eutropio, the Sea Rumble (Japanese: , Uminari no Eutoropio) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a member of the Levitath family. It can be found at level 45 in Primordia southwest of Seaswept Ridge.

Evil Mephites (Japanese: , Ibiru Mepitesu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Mephite family, and can be found at level 41-44 near FN Site 504 or north of FN Site 514 in Cauldros.
Exubera Stalactites (Japanese: , Tekusubera no Shōnyūseki) are unique collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Oblivia, in particular near FN Site 320 and FN Site 322.
Exploding Pansies (Japanese: , Bonpanjī) are common collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found at Seabird's Beak. Seventeen are required for Extreme Pansies.

The Exalting Paint (Japanese: , Kōsaido Henkagata Keikōtoryō) is a common collectible in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Cauldros, at T'phnom Shelf. Three bottles of Exalting Paint are needed for The Skell Spectrum.
Extra-large Cash Boxes (Japanese: , Jokkin-bako) are unique collectibles in . They can be found in Cauldros, especially the surroundings of FN Site 515 and the Kw'arah Cloister.
FN Prototypes 3 (Japanese: , F-N Shisaku 3-gōki) are unique collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Cauldros.
Europium Petramands (Japanese: , Yuuropiumu Aranea) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Petramand family and can be found at level 33-34 at Turtle Nest in Primordia.

Eustachio, the Eccentric (Japanese: , Kikotsu no Eusutakio) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a Cantor and can be found at level 43 at the entrance of Behemoth's Shadows in Sylvalum at night.
Etutanne, the Bloodthirsty (Japanese: , Kakketsu no Etutanne) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a member of the Adsecula family. It can be found at level 33 at Silent Mire in Primordia.

The Experimental Composite Qmoeva (Japanese: , Fukugō Shiken-gata Kumūba) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a Qmoeva Ganglion's Skell. It can be found at level 59 at Talon Rock Summit, south of the Drop Shaft in Primordia during nighttime.

The Experimental Compact Zig (Japanese: , Kogata Shiken-gata Jigu) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a Ganglion Zig machine. It can be found at level 20 west of Scholes Battlegrounds in Cauldros, on the southernmost heights of the ruins and overlooking the sea.

The Experimental Second-Gen Zig (Japanese: , Dai-ni Sedai Shiken-gata Jigu) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a Zig Ganglion machine. It can be found at level 58 guarding the bridge to the Kitsune Stronghold in Cauldros.

Evil Gerrids (Japanese: , Ibiru Girafa) are minor enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Gerrid family, and can be found at level 41-50 in various places in Sylvalum, such as Anvil Sandplain, Sylvalum Searoad, or Den of the Dead.
Everfreeze Ores are common Precious Resources in Xenoblade Chronicles X. Three pieces are required during Pollution Solution. Two are required to build a level 60 Zenith-Cannon.
Extra Armor is a Skill in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is unlocked as a Psycorruptor at rank 6. Cross and Mia can use this skill.
Ether Guard is a Skill in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is unlocked as a Mastermind at rank 1.
Evasion Up is a ground Armor stat Augment in and . It increases the evasion stat of a party member by a fixed amount. The Skell equivalent is SpecUp.EVA.
Evasion Boost is a ground Armor stat Augment in and . It increases the evasion stat of a party member by a fixed percentage. The Skell equivalent is Boost.EVA.

Every Dog Has Its Day is a Heart-to-Heart in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located at the south side of Deliverance Park, southeast side of the grass block, in the Residential District of New Los Angeles between Lao and Cross in the early morning.
Evello Eradication is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from the Curators and the primary destination is Oblivia.
Extreme Fluffiness is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from Dodonga Caravan to obtain Green Simius Manes in Noctilum.
Extreme Pansies is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from the Interceptors and the primary destination is Sylvalum.

Evergreen Aprica Antlers are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from green Apricas, or for 90 Reward Tickets at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks. They are components in I and V Artful Execution Surge augments.

Evolved Insidia Claws are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from green Insidias, or for 66 Reward Tickets at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks. They are components in I and V Aural Cloaking and Cloak.SOUND augments.
Evello A is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a black feathered evello variant. It can be obtained from Roderick, the Fleet-Footed in Primordia.
Evello B is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a brown feathered evello variant. It can be obtained from Ludvik, the Picky Eater in Oblivia.

Evolution at Work is a Squad Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is part of BLADE Mission No.6, and is unlocked when the Squad has completed the Squad Task of hunting twenty Piscinoids. It can be accepted at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks.

Experimental Organisms is a Squad Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is part of BLADE Mission No.9, and is unlocked if the Squad accessed the Data Unit during Raiding the Ganglion. It can be accepted at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks.
Evasion Drive is a ground armor Skell Augment in and that increases the evasion of the party member's Skell. Its effect caps at 100%.
Ether Res Up is a ground armor attribute resistance Augment in and that increases ether attribute resistance. The Skell equivalent is SpecUp.ETHER-RES.
Extend Aura is an armor Augment in Xenoblade Chronicles X that increases the duration of Auras.
Extend Taunt is an armor Augment in Xenoblade Chronicles X that extends the effects of the Taunt debuff.

Extend Debuff Res Down is an armor Augment in Xenoblade Chronicles X that extends the effects of the Debuff Res Down debuff.
The Ethereal Glaive: Helldragon is a melee weapon in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a level 50 Longsword dropped by the tyrant Sharnaak, the Technician.
Extend Blaze is a ground weapon art mod Augment in and that extends the effects of the Blaze Debuff when inflicted by an Art. The Skell equivalent is TimeEx.BLAZE.
Extend Shock is a ground weapon art mod Augment in and that extends the effects of the Shock Debuff when inflicted by an Art. The Skell equivalent is TimeEx.SHOCK.
Extend Physical Res Down is a ground weapon art mod Augment in and that extends the effects of the Physical Res Down Debuff when inflicted by an Art. The Skell equivalent is TimeEx.PHYS-DOWN.
Extend Beam Res Down is a ground weapon art mod Augment in and that extends the effects of the Beam Res Down Debuff when inflicted by an Art. The Skell equivalent is TimeEx.BEAM-DOWN.
Extend Ether Res Down is a ground weapon art mod Augment in and that extends the effects of the Ether Res Down Debuff when inflicted by an Art. The Skell equivalent is TimeEx.ETHER-DOWN.
Extend Thermal Res Down is a ground weapon art mod Augment in and that extends the effects of the Thermal Res Down Debuff when inflicted by an Art. The Skell equivalent is TimeEx.THERM-DOWN.
Extend Electric Res Down is a ground weapon art mod Augment in and that extends the effects of the Electric Res Down Debuff when inflicted by an Art. The Skell equivalent is TimeEx.ELEC-DOWN.
Extend Gravity Res Down is a ground weapon art mod Augment in and that extends the effects of the Gravity Res Down Debuff when inflicted by an Art. The Skell equivalent is TimeEx.GRAV-DOWN.
Extend Overdrive is an armor Augment in Xenoblade Chronicles X that increases the duration of Overdrive.
Ether Res Down is a stat debuff in Xenoblade Chronicles X. Ether Res Down increases the damage taken from ether-attribute attacks.

Experia Glyphs are rare materials in . They can be dropped by Level 20-29 Unique Monsters, most of which are in Satorl Marsh. According to their description, the truth of experience is inscribed on them and like every glyph, they sell for a high price on the market.

Experience Points, also known as EXP, are gained by killing monsters, completing quests and achievements, and discovering Landmarks, Locations or Secret Areas. The amount of experience in and can be amplified by several ways including linking skills, gems, and defeating high level monsters (for example enemies 6+ levels higher than party member). When enough is obtained, a character gains a level. Levels can be raised up to level 99; after that, experience is just a number. It takes 20,116,778 EXP to reach Level 99.

Evileye Mambor (Japanese: , Jagan no Nebyura) is a Unique Monster in . It is a member of the Aspar family, as well as a Driver, and can be found at level 54 on the Path of the Believer at the Cliffs of Morytha. Executor is a status effect in . It is similar to Instant Death in . It is a buff that makes attacks have a small chance to instantly defeat an enemy, dropping their HP to zero. It will only affect enemies within a specific type (Aerial, Aquatic, Beast, Humanoid, Insect, Machine, Titan) with the exception of Blades and Standards, for which there is no corresponding specialized effect. Unique Monsters, Bosses and Challenge Mode Enemies are completely immune to the status, however level differences do not affect the activation of the effect, making all other regular enemies vulnerable to it.
